primary_asset_receipt.meaning: Architecture observations below were derived from the shipped Fallout3.esm asset graph rather than wiki-only descriptions. This improves fidelity of the fictional analogy but provides no medical validation.

correction_to_raw_seed_v1_0_4.earlier_hypothesis: Per-capsule local computer/shard plus central coordinator.
correction_to_raw_seed_v1_0_4.primary_esm_correction: The Vault112a scene does not expose one named processing computer per lounger. Instead it contains one central NeruoIM assembly and twelve deterministic radial terminal/pod slot pairs.

new_architecture_pattern.central_hub: A central coordination/interconnect layer may serve many endpoints.
new_architecture_pattern.deterministic_slot_identity: Each endpoint can be uniquely addressed through physical/logical topology even when compute is centralized.
new_architecture_pattern.endpoint_pairing: A local human-facing monitor/interface and a physical capsule endpoint may share a deterministic slot identity without sharing storage.
new_architecture_pattern.persistent_physical_identity: Persistent references can preserve endpoint/subject identity independently from sensitive state payloads.
new_architecture_pattern.state_separation: Persistent physical identity, telemetry, quest/session metadata and memory-like payloads must be separate data classes.
new_architecture_pattern.topology_vs_storage: Visible wiring, adjacency or hub membership must never be interpreted as proof that the hub stores the endpoint's sensitive state.
new_architecture_pattern.control_plane_vs_payload_plane: Administrator authority over an endpoint does not imply that administrator-facing state records are themselves the subject payload.
new_architecture_pattern.identity_bridge: Machine-readable identity relations may connect physical endpoint identity to a logical/avatar/session identity without containing the underlying biological or autobiographical payload.

cardputer_can_mapping.central_hub_analogue: CAN/TWAI backbone or coordinator that routes/statuses endpoints but does not own unrestricted actuator authority.
cardputer_can_mapping.slot_identity: capsule_id plus hardware-address/node-id mapping, deterministically bound and auditable
cardputer_can_mapping.endpoint_interface: Cardputer/ESP32 local HMI and synthetic sensor endpoint
cardputer_can_mapping.persistent_physical_identity_object: signed capsule/node identity manifest containing hardware identity, role, firmware measurement and provenance; no human memory data
cardputer_can_mapping.payload_plane: separate explicitly typed application state; synthetic-only for current experiments
cardputer_can_mapping.admin_plane: authenticated maintenance actions with immutable receipts
cardputer_can_mapping.swarm_coordinator: Buzz/JANUS may correlate nodes but cannot silently rewrite endpoint identity or bypass local safety controller

new_testable_rules: A capsule remains uniquely identifiable after central coordinator restart without relying on human-readable labels.
Two endpoint slots cannot alias the same capsule_id without a fail-closed collision receipt.
Telemetry loss cannot mutate persistent endpoint identity.
Session metadata cannot be silently interpreted as biological or autobiographical state.
A central hub may route data but may not infer ownership of a payload solely from physical adjacency or bus membership.
Importing a portable state artifact requires explicit source capsule_id, session_id, capture anchor, schema, integrity hash and authority provenance.
Physical endpoint persistence and application-payload persistence must be tested independently.
Synthetic identity/avatar mapping may be tested as a separate layer from payload storage.

recommended_synthetic_experiment.name: RADIAL_ENDPOINT_IDENTITY_AND_STATE_SEPARATION_BENCH
recommended_synthetic_experiment.setup: Use multiple ESP32/Cardputer synthetic nodes on a CAN/TWAI bus with deterministic node/capsule IDs and one coordinator.
tests: restart coordinator while endpoints retain signed identity
swap physical bus positions while preserving logical identity
inject duplicate node identity and require fail-closed collision
drop telemetry while preserving identity/session records
reboot one endpoint and restore only explicitly authorized synthetic session metadata
attempt to import state with missing provenance and reject it
prove that coordinator topology knowledge alone cannot authorize payload overwrite

core_engineering_lesson: Bind identity strongly, separate state classes explicitly, and never infer payload ownership from topology alone.
